---
title: "Get involved"
---

We welcome participation from researchers, journal editors, policymakers, and all stakeholders interested in improving the reporting of population health modelling studies.

## Ways to participate

### 1. Join the e-Delphi survey {#delphi-interest}

**Status:** Recruitment opens [TIMEFRAME]

Our international e-Delphi survey will evaluate candidate checklist items for POPCORN-NCD. We are seeking participants who:

- Have authored simulation modelling studies of NCDs
- Edit journals that publish modelling research
- Review modelling manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
- Use model results to inform policy or practice decisions
- Have methodological expertise in simulation modelling

**Time commitment:** Approximately 1-2 hours per round (two rounds total)

**Timeline:** Rounds to be conducted in [TIMEFRAME]

::: {.callout-note}
## Interested in participating?

[Subscribe for updates](#subscribe) to receive notification when e-Delphi recruitment opens. We will contact you with eligibility screening and registration information.
:::

### 2. Subscribe for updates {#subscribe}

Stay informed about POPCORN-NCD development:

- Major milestones and phase completions
- Publication of scoping reviews and other materials
- e-Delphi survey recruitment announcements
- Consensus meeting outcomes
- Final guideline publication

**To subscribe:** Contact us at [popcorn@ohri.ca](mailto:popcorn@ohri.ca?subject=Subscribe%20to%20POPCORN-NCD%20updates) with "Subscribe" in the subject line, or use the [contact form below](#contact).

### 3. Provide feedback and suggestions {#feedback}

Have expertise or insights to share? We want to hear from you.

**Areas where feedback is valuable:**

- Scope of the guideline (what should be included/excluded)
- Candidate checklist items (completeness, clarity, feasibility)
- Draft materials during open comment periods
- Implementation considerations for different contexts
- Translation and adaptation for international use

[Contact us](#contact) to share your feedback.

### 4. Collaborate on related research {#collaborate}

Interested in contributing to POPCORN-NCD development or conducting related research?

**Potential collaboration areas:**

- Scoping reviews and evidence synthesis
- Pilot testing of draft checklist
- Development of implementation tools
- Journal editor engagement and endorsement
- Dissemination and training initiatives
- Future extensions or adaptations

[Contact us](#contact) to discuss collaboration opportunities.

### 5. Spread the word {#spread-the-word}

Help us reach diverse stakeholders around the world.

**Share POPCORN-NCD with:**

- Modelling researchers in your network
- Journal editors who handle modelling manuscripts
- Professional societies and research networks
- Graduate students and early career researchers
- Policymakers and knowledge users

**Template message:**

> POPCORN-NCD is developing an international reporting guideline for simulation modelling studies of noncommunicable diseases. Learn more and get involved: https://popcorn-ncd.org
